identification: Set of 4 tripod-footed cup and saucer sets with black piano key / musical note decoration on white glaze, described as Anne Reilly art pottery. Anne Reilly is an Australian studio potter (Bellingen NSW, active since the 1980s, postmodern/Memphis-influenced style). Tripod-footed saucer form matches an eBay AU sale of an Anne Reilly postmodern cup and saucer. Only one photo available.
marks_seen: No maker's mark readable in the single photo (bases not shown). Four cups and saucers, each saucer on three conical legs, black piano keys, treble clefs and notes.
google_searches: 'Anne Reilly art pottery musical cups saucers piano keys'; 'Anne Reilly Australian potter piano keys cup saucer sold price'; 'Anne Reilly postmodern Australian art pottery 1980s Sottsass cup saucer'; '"Anne Reilly" pottery cup saucer three legs 1980s Australian studio ceramics sold'. Found Anne Reilly Pottery Instagram (Bellingen NSW) and an auction-house catalogue listing an Anne Reilly bowl; no price.

entries.note: One Anne Reilly postmodern cup and saucer (yellow/purple Memphis-style design, same tripod saucer form), fixed price. Different decoration; single set, not four. Listing page shows ended at A$149.99, Terapeak records A$141.98 (likely Best Offer or postage-adjusted).

viewing_check: Estimate $50-70, current bid $10 for all 4 sets. Only one SOLD comparable found (A$142 for one set in Aug 2025), so the 4 musical sets could be worth well more than estimate if they behave similarly, but one sale is not a trend. Check bases for Anne Reilly signature/mark, chips to the three legs (fragile), cracks and that all four match. Postage is awkward, fragile.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU: 'Anne Reilly pottery' (1), 'Anne Reilly cup saucer' (1), 'Anne Reilly' (irrelevant DVDs), 'Anne Reilly studio pottery Bellingen' (0), 'postmodern australian pottery cup saucer tripod legs' (0). Google x4. Fetched the eBay listing to confirm match. Did not try US/GB marketplaces or Australian auction sites beyond Google.
flip_reason: Only 1 comparable sale (A$142 for one decorated cup and saucer, Aug 2025); musical design unproven. Current bid $10, so up to 4 sets could resell if each fetches near $100+, but fragile and thin evidence.

Bowl 2: smaller wavy ruffled red bowl on a clear amber-tinted disc foot with pontil, probably Murano or a similar Italian/other maker. No maker marks seen; attribution not possible beyond Murano-style.
